title: Create claim-root ledger and concrete packet sealing procedure
goal: Bind intended J01–J17 obligations to actual elaborated declarations only when those declarations exist.
acceptance_criteria: Unbuilt roots are marked missing rather than synthesized as passed; public API and codec roots remain explicit.
Sealing fills exact target/source/type/meaning/binding/validator pins and scoped proof-body selectors before a ticket becomes claimable.
Dependencies refer to merged accepted commits, not proposed PRs; each six-hour scope is rehearsed or split before opening.
Manual/bootstrap packets may use approved review checklists; mathematical packets require the operational VJ-053 envelope.
human_review: Maintainer semantic owner approves every sealed root and packet
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Project source and concrete declarations are not yet bootstrapped; maintainer must instantiate and freeze this template before any live claim.
